subject: Update zfree on data in test_crc64combine before return. (#548)
reason: The change only adds zfree(data) cleanup on early-return error paths inside the unit test file src/unit/test_crc64combine.c, fixing a memory leak in the test harness itself. It does not touch any server, command, replication, persistence or tool code, so no runtime behaviour of valkey-server or its tools changed and no fuzzer scenario can exercise it.
